leads.title: War of the four kings, rescue of Lot, Melchizedek ↔ The Most High: the scrolls of Abraham and Moses
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 shared wording.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/08-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: God Most High (El Elyon), creator/possessor of heaven and earth (weight 5.8). Pair score 5.8.

Only in War of the four kings, rescue of Lot, Melchizedek: Valley full of bitumen pits into which fleeing kings fall; The patriarch's trained men number 318; Patriarch pursues captors with a small force and rescues his kinsman; Hero refuses to take spoils, not even a thread or sandal strap; Four eastern kings make war against five kings of the plain; Oath sworn by raising the hand to God; A tenth of everything given to a priest; A priest-king of Salem brings bread and wine and blesses the patriarch; Ancient giant or Rephaite peoples (Rephaim, Zuzim, Emim, Horites) defeated.

Only in The Most High: the scrolls of Abraham and Moses: God will make the prophet recite so that he will not forget, except what God wills; 'I YHWH make all things, who alone stretched out the heavens, who spread out the earth - who was with me?'; The most wretched burns in the great fire, in which he neither dies nor lives; The message is in the former scrolls, the scrolls of Abraham and Moses; God proportioned the soul and inspired it with (knowledge of) its wickedness and its piety; who purifies it prospers; God pours down rain, splits the earth and makes grain, grapes, olives, palms and pasture grow, as provision and sign.
